chunk.content: The yellowfin goatfish (Mulloidichthys vanicolensis) is often confused with the goldband goatfish (Upeneus moluccensis) because it also has a single golden band along its sides.
chunk.source_quote: Mulloidichthys vanicolensis: often confused with U. moluccensis because it also has a single golden band along sides
